svg.title: Scale floor plan for a studio with a measured doorway
svg.desc: First-party plan of a 7 meter by 5 meter studio at scale 1 drawing centimeter equals 1 actual meter. The 7 by 5 centimeter rectangle is drawn at one consistent 30-pixel-per-centimeter paper scale. A 1.5 meter doorway is shown by a 45-pixel gap on the bottom wall; this is a genuine opening, not a fully closed side. The learner must create a new measured and labeled plan, add a scale key, explain the door placement and verify it with a partner.
svg.text: An original floor plan: 1 cm of drawing = 1 m of room
Student draws a new accurate floor plan and peer-checks all measured features.
